scope: DRON original Unit SHP fire-frame arm for all256 facing bytes and eight countdown steps at eight canonical headings; original Unit AI counter arithmetic edges.

Original Facing constructor4C91E0 and Set4C9300 initialize each declared byte heading. The admitted undisguised/eight-facing selector starts73C62B, executes Current4C93D0 and the firing branch, and stops73C725 before subsequent drawing.

Counter-step inputs are supplied signed dwords; original7363C9..7363DE performs the decrement/clamp. The INT_MIN control preserves wrapping arithmetic. Full Unit AI admission and lifecycle are covered separately, not inferred from this slice.
substitutions: No instructions, native calls, frame values or counter outputs are replaced. The slices do not execute Draw_It's admission, blitter, pixels or negative-counter Stand/Walk branches; no full-scene equivalence claim.
